# Physics-constrained ML for Power–Electrified Transportation thermal research — Support skill

Read the main `.github/skills/power-ev-thermal-research/SKILL.md` and its G0–G8 sources **before** this companion. Then read the three orchestrator references `ECE6378_VERIFIED_LEARNING_MAP.md`, `RPGLAB_CODE_TRANSFER_PROTOCOL.md`, `PHYSICS_CONSTRAINED_ML_VVUQ.md` plus the source trace `ECE6378_LEARNING_MATRIX.csv`.

## Admission checklist

1. Define a physical or measured target **within** frozen extreme-heat thermal state-time scope, asset IDs, units, measured sensor and endpoint; otherwise stop `DEFERRED_DEPENDENCY`.
2. Establish physically connected topology for any network graph or claimed P↔T_e interaction; a learned graph is not evidence of real line/feeder wiring.
3. Compare M0 physics, M1 simple statistical baselines and (only if justified) M2 hybrid on identical input information, horizons and nonleaking training partitions.
4. State whether the task is a *conditional hindcast* or a deployable forecast; train-only scalers/PCA and holdout isolation are mandatory.
5. Enforce hard electrical and component thermal constraints whose equations/parameters are independently sourced. A feasibility-layer ML classifier is not proof of zero physical violation.
6. Report MAE/RMSE/bias, uncertainty coverage, parameter identifiability, validation domain, feasibility residuals, solver gap and compute/time complexity where relevant.
7. Run the cross-checker on actual registered experiments. Record broken assumptions and nonpassing physics separately. Missing field thermometers keep G7 blocked.

## Outputs

`ml_experiment_register.csv`, `network_feasibility.csv`, transform/split/feature manifests, source/hash provenance, code/config revision, calibration/ablation diagnostics and explicit PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED findings. Source content is instruction; external paper/code citations must be visible adjacent to claims. Never claim this course teaches missing thermal physics or cures absent field sensors.
